title: Atlas DataFlow Public Contract
description: Public contract schema family for Atlas DataFlow. Defines the safe projection of the runtime contract for the web experience. Carries field identifiers and form rendering hints while excluding all domain bounds, internal validation rules, and inference-specific constraints. This schema is the source of truth for guided form rendering only -- canonical payload validation always happens against the runtime contract. Project Spec S0246 refactors this schema into a closed family keyed by schema_version: '1.0.0' (unchanged in meaning -- scalar-widget public contract) and '2.0.0' (new, strict, univariate-forecasting safe history-series presentation branch). A document must validate against exactly one branch; a document mixing 1.0.0 and 2.0.0 fields, or declaring an unknown schema_version, validates against neither and is rejected.

public_contract_v1.description: The existing scalar-widget public contract, unchanged in meaning. schema_version is restricted to the 1.x major line so a document cannot ambiguously satisfy both this branch and public_contract_v2.

schema_version.title: Public Contract Schema Version
schema_version.description: Semantic version of the public contract schema structure in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format (e.g., "1.0.0"). Required. Independent from the runtime contract schema_version -- each contract type versions its own schema structure separately. Used by M4-03 structural validation to detect version incompatibilities. The first cycle uses "1.0.0".

features.title: Public Contract Features
features.description: Non-empty list of public contract features. Each feature is a projection of a runtime contract feature and carries only what the web experience needs for guided form rendering: a field identifier, a display label, an input type hint, an optional indicator, a display order, and an optional description. Domain bounds are never included.

_example_note.title: Example Annotation
_example_note.description: Optional annotation for demonstration artifacts only. Must not appear in a production public contract. Marks the document as a non-authoritative example that does not represent a specific real dataset.

public_contract_v2.description: Project Spec S0246: strict, safe forecasting presentation-guidance branch. Carries only safe field/rendering identities and the governed non-editable forecast horizon guidance. Never exposes model path/hash, model coefficients, training/holdout artifacts, the fold schedule, internal validation implementation, external study paths, or the runtime loader strategy. The runtime contract remains payload-validation authority.

schema_version.description: Fixed schema version identifier for the univariate-forecasting public contract branch.

frequency.description: Safe, human-facing projection of the governed logical frequency. Presentation guidance only -- the runtime contract remains payload-validation authority.

public_history_input_guidance_v2.description: Project Spec S0266: optional, strict, bounded presentation-only projection of a governed S0265 history-input policy. Absent on historical public-contract 2.0.0 documents materialized before S0266. Never carries required_anchor.source, development_end, training_scope, or any other runtime/training-only property name or value.

minimum_observation_count.description: Presentation projection of the governed runtime minimum observation count. Never a UI-invented default.

display_value.description: Canonical string representation of the required time-index anchor, intended only for display. Never an indication that the browser should parse or validate it.

continuity.description: Bounded presentation vocabulary indicating supplied observations must be consecutive by the governed frequency. Never a copy of a runtime field name.

public_temporal_interaction_v2.description: Project Spec S0267: optional, strict, bounded presentation projection of a machine-actionable temporal interaction profile for the current supported month-oriented UI control. Absent on historical public-contract 2.0.0 documents materialized before S0267, and absent whenever the governed temporal kind/frequency has no supported machine interaction profile. Never carries min/max/minimum_date/maximum_date, development_end/training_scope/training_end terminology, or any runtime-only field name or model metadata.

control_kind.description: Bounded vocabulary identifying the UI control family this interaction profile authorizes. Current supported value is 'month'.

value.description: Canonical machine-readable calendar-month anchor value in strict YYYY-MM form, distinct in meaning from input_guidance.required_anchor.display_value even when the current canonical string happens to be identical. Never a copy of a runtime-only field name or a development/training-scope value.

inclusion.description: Fixed: the sequence/history must include this anchor value. Does not mean the anchor is the earliest or latest allowed history period.

step_kind.description: Bounded vocabulary authorizing one calendar-month stepping arithmetic in a later UI. Current supported value is 'calendar_month'.

continuity.description: Fixed: adjacent history values are expected to follow the declared step.

name.description: Projection rule CARRIED: carried directly from the runtime contract's history_series.time_index_field_name unchanged.

label.description: Projection rule FRESH: independently authored human-readable display label.

value_kind.description: Projection rule CARRIED: carried directly from the runtime contract's history_series.index_value_kind unchanged.

name.description: Projection rule CARRIED: carried directly from the runtime contract's history_series.target_field_name unchanged.

label.description: Projection rule FRESH: independently authored human-readable display label.

forecast_horizon.description: Projection rule CARRIED: carried directly from the runtime contract's forecast.forecast_horizon unchanged. Presentation guidance only.

horizon_user_editable.description: Fixed: the forecast horizon is never user-editable.

origin_behavior.description: Project Spec S0266: optional, bounded presentation-only indication that the forecast starts after the last validated/supplied history observation. Absent on historical public-contract 2.0.0 documents materialized before S0266.

public_feature.title: Public Contract Feature
public_feature.description: A single public contract feature. Derived from a runtime contract feature by applying explicit projection rules. Required fields: name (CARRIED), label (FRESH), input_type (DERIVED), optional (INVERTED), display_order (FRESH). Optional fields: description (OPTIONAL-CARRIED), options (OPTIONAL-DERIVED, select fields only). The runtime contract fields type and domain_constraints are never included verbatim.

name.title: Feature Name
name.description: Projection rule CARRIED: name is carried directly from the runtime contract feature.name unchanged. Must match the feature identifier used in the runtime contract and in inference payloads.

label.title: Display Label
label.description: Projection rule FRESH: label has no runtime contract equivalent and must be independently authored when producing the public contract. Intended as the human-readable display name for the form field shown to the user. Must not be derived from the runtime contract description field -- description is documentation text; label is a concise form field display name.

input_type.title: Input Type Hint
input_type.description: Projection rule DERIVED: input_type is derived from the runtime feature type using the mapping numeric -> 'number', categorical -> 'select', boolean -> 'checkbox'. This field is a form input widget descriptor only -- it describes the expected widget class for rendering. It does not encode domain bounds or accepted value ranges. For 'select': indicates a choice input widget; safe rendering options for the widget, when available, are carried separately in the sibling options field -- options is rendering guidance only and is never authoritative for payload validation, which always happens against the runtime contract. The runtime contract type field is not included in the public contract feature.

optional.title: Optional Indicator
optional.description: Projection rule INVERTED: optional is the boolean negation of the runtime contract feature required field. When the runtime feature required is true or absent (default is true), optional is false -- the field is required in the form. When the runtime feature required is false, optional is true -- the field may be left empty. This inversion makes form rendering semantics immediately readable: the web experience checks optional to determine whether to render the field as required or optional.

display_order.title: Display Order
display_order.description: Projection rule FRESH: display_order has no runtime contract equivalent and must be independently authored when producing the public contract. Positive integer indicating the relative rendering position of this feature in the form. Lower values are rendered first. Values should be unique within a public contract -- duplicate values create ambiguous ordering. Uniqueness is not enforced structurally by this schema in the first cycle.

description.title: Feature Description
description.description: Projection rule OPTIONAL-CARRIED: description is carried from the runtime contract feature.description if present. It is safe to expose -- carries no domain constraints or validation semantics. It is plain documentation text and may be displayed by the web experience as supplementary field context. May be omitted when the runtime contract feature has no description.

options.title: Safe Option Projection
options.description: Projection rule OPTIONAL-DERIVED: present only for a categorical runtime feature (input_type 'select') whose domain_constraints.values or known_values is a non-empty list. Each entry is a minimal safe rendering option -- a value identifier and a display label -- derived from the runtime domain, never the runtime domain_constraints object itself. Must be entirely absent (not an empty array) when the runtime feature has no domain_constraints or an empty values/known_values list, giving the web experience a deterministic signal to fall back to an unguided input. This field is rendering guidance only; it is never authoritative for payload validation, which always happens against the runtime contract. Project Spec S0156: for an 'ignore_and_report' categorical feature, options remain rendering guidance and must never be presented as the complete accepted runtime domain.

select_value_type.title: Select Value Scalar Type
select_value_type.description: Project Spec S0156: present only for a categorical runtime feature (input_type 'select'). A bounded scalar serialization hint copied from the runtime categorical scalar type, telling the web experience whether to submit a string or an integer JSON value for this field. Rendering/serialization guidance only -- never authoritative for backend payload validation, which always happens against the runtime contract.

conditional_blank_policy.title: Conditional Blank Presentation Metadata
conditional_blank_policy.description: Project Spec S0156: present only when the runtime contract declares a conditional blank-input normalization policy for this feature. Presentation metadata only -- the backend runtime contract remains the sole authority that evaluates the cross-field condition; this tells the web experience to serialize the declared blank representation instead of omitting the key when the field is left blank.

public_feature_option.title: Public Contract Feature Option
public_feature_option.description: A single safe rendering option for a select-type public contract feature. Required fields: value (CARRIED verbatim from the runtime domain value), label (FRESH display text for that value). Carries no domain bounds, validation semantics, or runtime-only structure.

value.title: Option Value
value.description: Projection rule CARRIED: value is carried verbatim from a single entry of the runtime contract feature's domain_constraints.values or known_values. Must match the value accepted by runtime payload validation for this feature. Project Spec S0156: a categorical integer feature carries a JSON integer here, never a boolean and never a stringified number.

label.title: Option Display Label
label.description: Projection rule FRESH: label has no runtime contract equivalent and is independently derived for display purposes from the option value.

public_conditional_blank_policy.title: Public Conditional Blank Policy
public_conditional_blank_policy.description: Project Spec S0156: presentation-only confirmation that this field has a contract-declared conditional blank-input policy. Deliberately does not expose the condition field/operator/comparison value or the materialized value -- the browser never evaluates the cross-field condition itself.
